entities.summary: Hazel Claire Weekes MBE was an Australian general practitioner and health writer; she also had an early career as a research scientist working in the field of comparative reproduction. Weekes is considered by many as the pioneer of modern anxiety treatment; she wrote several books on dealing with anxiety disorders.
